description: Official release roster and activation-readiness rules for the first six licensed CPI/NFP shadow windows.

source_rules.authority: CPI and Employment Situation release dates must come from their BLS schedule pages.
source_rules.versioning: Preserve the normalized roster bytes and SHA-256 used for each readiness decision.
source_rules.refresh: Re-check the official page inside the registered activation refresh window because BLS updates the calendar as needed.

time_rules.named_zone: Convert 08:30 Eastern with America/New_York; fixed UTC offsets are prohibited.
time_rules.utc: Store the converted offset-aware UTC release timestamp.
time_rules.operator_timezone: Display an Asia/Tokyo timestamp for operations without using it as the event identity.

activation_rules.access: Credential and approved rights must pass before the access-ready deadline.
activation_rules.schedule: Only a roster rechecked inside the registered freshness window can activate a release.
activation_rules.components: Logical components are planning labels; provider event IDs must be resolved from the licensed pre-release capture before evidence enrollment.
activation_rules.expiry: A missed release can never be reconstructed and relabeled as a live shadow window.
